title: 第8章 纳气诀第9章 清风秘境
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
在修炼界，本源洞天的修炼不仅仅是对法力的驾驭，更是一种对心境的修炼。
修炼者需要时常静心凝神，以达到对本源洞天真意的感悟。
本源洞天，是修炼者精气神的体现，每个洞天都有其独特的意境和功能。
凌宇所修习的本源洞天之法为——纳气诀。这是一种最基础的炼气之法，但言简意赅，每次修炼都有新的收获。
《纳气诀》不仅仅是一种炼气之法，也是一种修心之法。
纳气诀:
修炼之道，首在制心守神，使心境澄澈宁静，方能调息修炼，有所精进。心若不静，则思绪如麻，杂乱无章，难以调气养神。气息紊乱，则体内先天之气隐匿不现。三才之气，无所不包，无所不聚，若运行不畅，则弊害丛生。
故遇诸事，当制心守神，淡然处之。凡欲为之事，当顺应自然之理。事未发，则勿起妄念；事已过，则当释然，如冰融于水，了无痕迹。应常使内心空灵无物，犹如无事之状，如此则心自静矣。心静而后神安，神安方能定志。
依此妙法，独处静室之中，稍坐片刻，盘膝稳坐，手握如固，闭目垂帘，内观本心。心之状态，当如婴孩，端坐于心舍之内。所谓“端坐”，非为形体之端正，实乃内心之宁静；“存如婴”，非指外在之形态，乃为心之混沌无知；“收心舍”，非是目见之物，而是心中清虚明朗，空灵澄澈，唯能感受，而不能目视。
然若拘泥于文字表象，则易堕入虚幻妄想之境，难达真正清静之境。当依法内观，行事顺其自然，方能洞察内心之奥秘。见心明性，则能照见本源洞天。洞天之照见，则可纳气入内，觉醒本源之力。纳气入洞天，造化自然而生，道亦渐成。
修炼本源洞天的境界有灵觉境，入道境，凝真境，洞虚境，灵虚境……
每一层又分为前期、中期、后期、圆满四个小境界。
体悟自己的本心，觉醒自己的本源洞天便为——灵觉境。
明悟洞天真意，以洞天之力驾驭天地之灵力，能够自由飞行便为——入道境。
凝炼洞天真意，能够将真意运用于作战或防御等行为便为——凝真境。
修炼者能够洞察虚空，感知到周围的微小变化，对天地之力的掌控更上一层楼就是——洞虚境。
修炼者灵台空明，与本源洞天融为一体，能够以洞天之力破碎虚空，短时间穿行于虚空之中，甚至进入虚空、归墟等地探索就是——灵虚境。
……
而以修炼全身窍穴为主的境界由低到高有:开窍境，明窍境，聚元境，融灵境，周天境……
每一层也分为前期、中期、后期、圆满四个小境界。

凌宇缓缓地伸了一个懒腰，结束了一晚上的打坐修炼。
自从开始修炼，他就以修炼代替睡觉，只有偶尔会小睡一会。
他感受了一下体内法力的增长，满意地笑了笑，然后走出了房门。
门外，清晨的阳光洒在凌宇的身上，给他带来丝丝温暖。
他深吸一口气，感受着清新的空气，心情格外舒畅。
“宇儿，修炼结束了？”看着凌宇走出房门，凌啸风笑着走了过来。
“是啊，爹。”凌宇回答。
“看你的状态不错，昨晚的修炼应该很有收获吧？”凌啸风轻声问道。
content_en:
In the world of cultivation, the cultivation of Origin Cave Heaven is not only the control of magic power, but also the cultivation of one's state of mind.
Practitioners need to be calm and focused at all times in order to realize the true meaning of the original cave.
The origin cave is the embodiment of the practitioner’s essence and spirit. Each cave has its own unique artistic conception and function.
The original method of cave heaven practiced by Ling Yu is - the art of absorbing qi. This is the most basic method of refining qi, but it is concise and concise, and you will gain something new every time you practice it.
"Naqi Jue" is not only a method of refining qi, but also a method of cultivating the mind.
The art of absorbing qi:
The way to practice is to control the mind and keep the spirit first, so that the state of mind is clear and peaceful, so that you can adjust your breath and practice, and make progress. If the mind is not calm, the thoughts will be numb and disorganized, making it difficult to regulate the energy and maintain the mind. If the breath is disordered, the innate Qi in the body will be hidden. The energy of the three talents is all-encompassing and all-encompassing. If it does not flow smoothly, harm will abound.
Therefore, when encountering any situation, you should control your mind, guard your mind, and deal with it calmly. Whatever you want to do, you should follow the laws of nature. Before something happens, don't have any delusional thoughts; after something has passed, be relieved, just like ice melting into water, leaving no trace. You should always make your heart empty and empty, as if nothing is happening. This way, your mind will be at peace. When the mind is calm, then the mind is at peace, and only when the mind is at peace can the mind be determined.
According to this wonderful method, sit alone in a quiet room for a while, sit cross-legged firmly, hold your hands firmly, close your eyes and hang the curtain, and meditate on your original mind. The state of the mind should be like that of a baby, sitting upright in the equanimity of the mind. The so-called "sitting upright" does not refer to the uprightness of the body, but actually the tranquility of the heart; "existing like a baby" does not refer to the external form, but the chaos and ignorance of the heart; "collecting the heart and giving up" does not refer to things that can be seen, but to the clear and empty mind, which can only be felt, not seen.
However, if you stick to the literal representation, you will easily fall into a state of illusion and delusion, and it will be difficult to reach a state of true tranquility. Only when you observe in accordance with the Dharma and act naturally will you be able to gain insight into the mysteries of your heart. If you see the clear nature of your mind, you can see the original cave. If you see the light of the cave sky, you can take in the Qi and awaken the original power. When the Qi enters the cave, creation will naturally arise, and the Tao will gradually be formed.
The realms of cultivating the Origin Cave Heaven include the realm of spiritual awareness, the realm of entering the Tao, the realm of condensation, the realm of cave void, the realm of spiritual void...
Each level is divided into four small realms: early stage, middle stage, late stage, and perfection.
Realizing one's own true heart and awakening to one's original cave is the realm of spiritual awareness.
To clearly understand the true meaning of the cave, to control the spiritual power of heaven and earth with the power of the cave, to be able to fly freely is to enter the realm of Taoism.
Condensing the true meaning of the cave, and being able to apply the true meaning to actions such as combat or defense is called the True Condensation Realm.
Practitioners can see into the void, perceive small changes in the surroundings, and control the power of heaven and earth to the next level - the cave void realm.
The cultivator's spiritual platform is empty and integrated with the original cave sky. He can use the power of the cave to break the void, travel through the void in a short time, and even enter the void, Guixu and other places to explore - the spiritual void realm.
…
The realms that focus on cultivating the body's acupoints are from low to high: the realm of opening the orifice, the realm of clear orifice, the realm of gathering elements, the realm of integrating spirits, the realm of Zhoutian...
Each level is also divided into four small realms: early stage, middle stage, late stage, and perfection.
Ling Yu stretched slowly and ended the night's meditation practice.
Since he started practicing, he has practiced practicing instead of sleeping, and only occasionally takes a nap.
He felt the increase in mana in his body, smiled with satisfaction, and then walked out of the door.
Outside the door, the early morning sunshine shone on Ling Yu's body, bringing him the slightest warmth.
He took a deep breath, felt the fresh air, and felt particularly comfortable.
"Yu'er, training is over?" Looking at Ling Yu walking out of the room, Ling Xiaofeng walked over with a smile.
"Yes, Dad." Ling Yu replied.
"Seeing that you are in good condition, your practice last night should have been very fruitful, right?" Ling Xiaofeng asked softly.
